§7Ready in about §a{eta} §7seconds, use §f/server {server} §7again then
announce.sleeping: §b[Idle Guard] §fServer §b{server} §fhas been empty for §a{minutes} §fminutes, now sleeping §7(wakes up on connect)
announce.waking: §b[Idle Guard] §f{player}§f is entering §b{server}§f, the server is starting… about §a{eta} §fseconds
announce.locked: §b[Idle Guard] §fServer §b{server} §ffailed §c{count} §ftimes, auto wake-up is locked, please check the logs
announce.stopped_manual: §b[Idle Guard] §fServer §b{server} §fhas been shut down §7(stopped manually, not sleeping — a connection will not start it)
detail.fake_took_over: placeholder server took over the port
detail.fake_bind_failed: placeholder server cannot bind the port: {error}
detail.stopped_no_fake: server stopped, placeholder server is taking over the port
detail.server_stopped_manual: server was shut down normally (exit code {code}), this is not a sleep
detail.wait_stop_timeout: timed out while waiting for the server to stop
detail.process_exited: the server process exited, check the server log
detail.wake_port_busy: the port stays occupied (the previous server may not have exited yet)
detail.wake_start_failed: failed to run the start command: {error}
detail.wake_ready_timeout: timed out while waiting for the server to be ready ({seconds}s)
detail.takeover_retrying: the placeholder server keeps retrying to take over the port
action.wake_cooldown: {server} was woken up just now and is still starting
action.wake_locked: {server} has auto wake-up locked (failed {count} times), run !!ig unlock {server} first
action.wake_done: {server} is up (took {seconds}s), you can enter now
action.wake_done_simple: {server} is up, you can enter now
action.sleep_not_needed: {server} is already {state}, no need to sleep it again
action.sleep_disabled: auto sleep for {server} is disabled or locked
action.sleep_timeout: timed out waiting for {server} to stop, giving up (check the server log)
action.stop_failed: failed to run the stop command: {error}
action.locked: {server} locked: it will not sleep or wake up by itself
action.unlocked: {server} unlocked: auto sleep and wake-up are back
action.no_owner: no instance manages {server}, cannot start or stop it{hint}
action.always_on: §b[Idle Guard] §fServer §b{server} §fis always-on (always_on=true), it will not be slept
hover.idle.always_on:
always-on server
never auto-stopped
sleep requests refused
hover.switch.always_on:
always-on server
no sleep button here
set always_on=false to change
action.hint_auto: ({server} has role auto, so the MCDR instance whose port matches it is the owner) that instance did not answer: check whether it is running, whether this plugin is installed there, and whether its bus address (servers[].bus) matches
action.hint_own: (in this instance's config the role of {server} is {role}, so no instance will start or stop it) to make it controllable, set its role to auto or self and install this plugin on the MCDR that manages it
action.no_owner_none_answered: {server}: nobody answered the {action} request (tried {addresses}) — the MCDR instance that owns it is probably not running; enable debug to see why each send failed
action.no_remote_bus: this instance does not manage {server}{hint}, and no bus address is configured for it (servers[].bus), so it cannot be controlled remotely — run the command on the MCDR instance that manages it
action.wait_timeout: the state of {server} did not change within {seconds}s, check !!ig status again
command.screen.help_hint: Click a command to run or fill it
command.screen.status_hint: hover the state for the idle timer; the switch is clickable
command.help.hover.status:
number / role / state / players
idle timer, plus a switch
no argument needed
command.help.hover.wake:
start it and wait until ready
connections do this too
numbers come from status
command.help.hover.sleep:
this only marks it as pending
it stops after {prefix} confirm
command.help.hover.lock:
while locked it never sleeps
and connections do not wake it
unlock when your work is done
command.help.hover.poll:
no need to wait a cycle
polls every backend server
interval: check_interval
command.help.hover.reload:
re-reads config and language
files, use it after editing
hover.role.self:
managed by this instance
started and stopped via MCDR
player count from MCDR events
hover.role.command:
started/stopped with commands
player count: status query
hover.role.watch:
watched only
notifications are forwarded
it is never started or stopped
hover.state.sleeping:
sleeping: server stopped
placeholder holds the port
a connection wakes it up
hover.state.offline:
server not running
no placeholder on the port yet
connections are refused
hover.state.stopped:
stopped manually (not a sleep)
the plugin keeps no port
a connection will not start it
use !!ig wake to bring it back
hover.idle.none:
not counting yet
counting starts once it is empty
hover.locked:
locked: never sleeps by itself
connections no longer wake it
use {prefix} unlock
command.unknown_server: no server with number or name {name} ({count} in total; use a number or a name, see !!ig status)
command.action.sleep_running: putting {server} to sleep… (stopping takes a few seconds, the result follows)
command.reload.failed: reload failed ({error}), please run !!MCDR plugin reload {plugin_id}
command.help.mcdr: Idle guard for backend servers: inspect and control their sleep state
command.help.hover.confirm:
lets the last {prefix} sleep work
after {seconds}s you must re-issue it
command.confirm.none: nothing is waiting for confirmation (start with {prefix} sleep <no.|name>)
command.confirm.expired: the last confirmation expired after {seconds}s, please re-issue {prefix} sleep
hover.col_index:
put this number in the command
e.g. {prefix} sleep {index}
hover.col_note: the @name is the MCDR running it
hover.col_switch: one click starts or stops it
hover.note:
{instance} manages this server
state and switch act through it
hover.switch.busy: it is changing state, wait a bit
action.sleep_has_players: {server} still has {count} player(s) online ({players}), refusing to sleep — it sleeps by itself once everyone leaves
action.sleep_has_players_anon: {server} still has {count} player(s) online (names not published by the server), refusing to sleep
action.sleep_unknown_players: cannot tell whether anyone is on {server} ({detail}), refusing to sleep to be safe
command.status.hint_players: servers with players are never put to sleep (manual commands are refused too)
command.action.busy: {server} is {state} right now, try again once it settles
command.action.sleep_has_players: {server} still has {count} player(s) online, refusing to sleep — it will sleep by itself once everyone leaves
hover.col_state: state and idle timer on hover
hover.idle.auto_off: auto sleep is off for it
hover.role.remote_self:
another MCDR instance runs it
state and switch act through it
